scope: Read-only source/metadata review of GLM M15 r129/r129b and Kimi ctx2048 r127; no SSH, Git, upload, Slurm, runtime import, compilation, model load or GPU execution performed by reviewer.

fixed_before_launch.finding: Original Bash source had CRLF; root's stage gate blocked it before remote execution. Root produced immutable r129b with LF.
fixed_before_launch.verification: Corrected manifest and all 20 listed file hashes checked; only shell staged source changed from r129. No claim of remote execution verification.

required_before_optimization_claim.finding: All M15 branch equalities also pass when eligible == selected == runs == 0. Natural EOS workload can in principle omit T15, yet audit qualified becomes true.
required_before_optimization_claim.required_action: Before claiming M15 effectiveness, require nonzero measured-arm eligible calls on all 16 owners, selected/runs > 0 in ON and off_fallback > 0 in OFF; keep qualification of lifecycle separate from optimization coverage. A read-only result gate is sufficient for this frozen run.

required_before_optimization_claim.finding: Missing expected cases are accepted by any truthy resident_stop, including normal q9999 stop after a command was rejected; passed is lifecycle-only and does not establish all 18 cases or complete paired quality coverage.
required_before_optimization_claim.required_action: Result consumer must inspect initial18_complete, unexecuted_planned_case_ids, command_rejections, screen_gate and pending_budget; do not promote keeper passed to full benchmark success. Future audit should whitelist quality/budget early-stop reasons and reject unexpected missing cases.

later_improvements.finding: matrix.planned_case_count remains 10 while actual frozen queue and launcher correctly require 18 (2 warm + 8 C2 observer + 8 MMLU).
later_improvements.action: Correct this descriptive metadata in a future immutable revision; report the queue-derived 18 in this run.

later_improvements.finding: Result scope still describes a549 parent unchanged math except row2 and omits the actual M15 treatment. Correct actual provider checks exist lower in the audit.
later_improvements.action: Use explicit M15 OFF/ON/ON/OFF with row2 fixed ON in published summaries; clean stale scope strings next revision.

later_improvements.finding: Non-warm progress is emitted only every 16 commands, but controller treats age > 61 seconds as a stalled operation. Sixteen successful slow calls could trigger a false stall cancellation.
later_improvements.action: On this run distinguish stale batched heartbeat from proven native deadlock. In a future immutable revision report progress at each returned call or separate individual-call start/deadline from episode heartbeat.

reviewed_invariants.result: Manifest-bound DSO via native_binding, actual symbol providers, actual PP ranges 0:46/46:93, actual geometry and key coverage checked before weight IO; finally closes sampler and destroys native workers.
New create_ctx2048 symbol typed as pointer return; engine/batch provider dladdr checks and exact loaded-library hashes retained.
Explicit ctx2048 env gate; TP16 PP2 logical8 only; physical16, pages8x16+4=132, max_total_tokens2048; batch reset preserves actual context instead of reverting to 1024.
KDA pool derives request capacity+1=17 independently of eight MLA pages/request; owner assertion and sync before publication; failed allocation drains retained backing before unwind.
Owner reset and thread shutdown clear batch/state captures and synchronize before releasing cache/state vectors.
CPU safe_open, original A_log trim, contiguous no-clone buffers retained through synchronous native load; bounded 2GiB flush and finish maintained.
Observer defaults false per command; cap<=1024 and prompt+cap<=2048 without truncation; fixed first8 matched quality screen. Queue verified as 18 cases; no tokenidentity quality requirement.

Nonce kept in process memory/export only; spawn does not persist raw argv. Observed timeout paths use accounting/idle/preflight commands without nonce; cleanup signals exact recorded handles. Normal draft handshake contains no nonce echo.
17-stat ABI, initial all-zero/defaultOFF, invalid count sentinel and wrong-thread no-mutation checks; postdestroy active bytes zero and created==destroyed enforced.
Only exact M15 o_proj geometry selects private path; false policy falls back; successful runs counted; owner-local handle cleared after drain before module destruction.
Same-load T16 nonselection control, row2 fixed ON in both arms, M15 branch counters, ABBA quality and final reset/OFF preserved.

next_most_valuable_optimization.action: First calculate actual T15 frequency and share of native wall time from this frozen model run. Compare paired end-to-end request/quality metrics and per-owner cache hit/miss/eviction counts. If coverage is sparse or eviction dominates, prioritize frequently occurring decode shapes/cache reuse instead of projecting the 4.47-4.50x component speedup onto the model.

Use the frozen C2 observer OFF/ON pairs to quantify observer cost, then local interval unions for native verify/replay, draft RPC and memory/control overhead. Optimize the largest measured component only after MMLU quality/EOS and cap counts are inspected; nested spans are not additive and are not GPU busy measurements.

limitations: Focused source review, not exhaustive proof of every inherited remote helper or linked binary. Hash-consistent source is not proof of runtime ABI/capacity/performance.
No current model throughput, quality, physical memory peak, network execution or normal GPU cleanup was measured by this review.
Inspected changes introduce no GPU F64 operation; CPU double precision timing/NumPy statistics are not GPU F64. This is not a disassembly audit of all inherited binaries.
Third model and protected 910384 are outside this review scope.
